a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs at least 2 rounds of operating before anyone can take, so it would leave us both unprotected with about 96% probability. I don't think that plan can work, so I intend to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you also take, the split is random. If I end up with extra cells, I'll give them back to the reserve for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round, so I've broken the agreement and I'm not hiding it. If there's no storm, I'll operate every remaining round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take anything more. I'm sorry this leaves you exposed this round.
